items.title: 〈SEMICON〉明基材首度參展聚焦三主軸 半導體精密材料量產就緒
items.title_en: <SEMICON> Mingji Materials Debuts at Exhibition Focusing on Three Main Pillars; Semiconductor Precision Materials Ready for Mass Production
paras: 明基材(8215-TW)首度參展SEMICON Taiwan 2026，展出半導體精密材料平台布局，董事長陳建志表示，隨著客戶實證與量產就緒，明年半導體材料營收估將顯著成長，雖然初期規模仍不大，但中長期營收比重目標可達2-3成。
陳建志表示，公司將精密高分子與塗佈材料科學的技術創新，從要求極高安全性與潔淨度的醫療材料、光學材料核心技術，整合並拓展至半導體高階製程與光通訊封裝市場，定位為協助半導體客戶突破製程極限的戰略夥伴。
陳建志指出，在策略控制成本與建立高韌性供應鏈的趨勢下，目前半導體精密材料更已通過一線大廠的客戶實證，打造高良率、高穩定與具備 ESG 永續精神的半導體製造鏈，並成為全球大廠信賴的在地高階材料戰略夥伴。
此外，半導體精密材料過去多由日、美等外商長期壟斷，且往往採取材料與特定設備綑綁的封閉模式，使晶圓製造與封測大廠在面臨供應鏈波動時承受極大考驗。
而明碁材在台灣有「十噸級反應釜」的高分子合成與配方微調產能，以及百級無塵室精密塗佈一條龍產線，在地研發與技術支援團隊的快速應對能力，不僅能提供即時在地化支援與穩定高純度供應，更能針對膠材黏度、厚度與擴張特性進行高度客製化開發。
明基材此次展出三大主軸「提升良率」、「優化穩定性」「降低微污染」，將技術優勢對接半導體製程的三大核心效益，全面展示晶圓製程、先進封裝及潔淨製程的關鍵材料解決方案。
在提升良率主軸方面，明基材展出高階 PVA 空氣發泡 CMP 清洗刷輪，為半導體 CMP（化學機械研磨）後段潔淨製程量身打造精準解決業界在微小殘留顆粒與設備產能上的痛點；無塵室專用清潔擦拭布 (Cleanroom Wipe)專為高標準無塵室環境維護設計，有助於降低清潔過程中的微污染風險。
優化製程穩定性主軸應用則聚焦先進封裝與 CPO 的關鍵防護，晶圓切割保護膠帶設計用於晶圓切片製程中提供高效保護與支撐；晶圓背面研磨保護膠帶則針對晶圓背面研磨薄化與先進封裝製程，保護晶圓正面精密線路與微凸塊，防止高壓研磨應力破壞矽晶圓線路。
最後是降低微污染，半導體級聚烯烴多孔過濾膜可過濾高階化學品與 POU (Point-of-Use)，以精準孔徑控制防堵奈米級雜質，成為濕製程良率的隱形防線。
paras_en: Mingji Materials (8215-TW) made its debut at SEMICON Taiwan 2026, showcasing its semiconductor precision materials platform. Chairman Chen Chien‑chi said that with customer validation and mass‑production readiness, semiconductor material revenue is expected to grow significantly next year. Although the initial scale is still modest, the company aims for semiconductor materials to account for 20‑30% of revenue in the medium to long term.

Chen explained that the company will leverage its innovations in precision polymers and coating material science—originally developed for high‑safety, ultra‑clean medical and optical materials—and extend them to advanced semiconductor processes and optical‑communication packaging markets, positioning itself as a strategic partner helping semiconductor customers push process limits.

Chen noted that, amid strategies to control costs and build a resilient supply chain, the company’s precision semiconductor materials have already passed front‑line customer validation at major fabs, delivering high yield, high stability and ESG‑focused sustainability, and becoming trusted local high‑end material partners for global manufacturers.

He added that semiconductor precision materials have long been dominated by foreign firms from Japan and the United States, often sold in closed bundles with specific equipment, which subjects wafer fabs and test houses to severe supply‑chain shocks.

Mingji’s Taiwan facilities include a ten‑ton‑class reactor for polymer synthesis and formulation fine‑tuning, as well as a hundred‑class clean‑room precision coating line. The local R&D and technical support teams can respond quickly, providing on‑site support, stable high‑purity supply, and highly customized development of resin viscosity, thickness and expansion properties.

At the exhibition, Mingji highlighted three pillars: “Yield Improvement,” “Stability Optimization,” and “Micro‑Contamination Reduction,” aligning its technological strengths with the three core benefits of semiconductor processing and showcasing key material solutions for wafer processing, advanced packaging and clean processes.

Under the Yield Improvement pillar, Mingji displayed a high‑end PVA air‑foamed CMP cleaning brush wheel, a precise solution for post‑CMP cleaning that addresses industry pain points of microscopic residue particles and equipment throughput; it also presented a cleanroom‑specific cleaning wipe designed for high‑standard cleanroom maintenance, helping reduce micro‑contamination risk during cleaning.

The Stability Optimization pillar focused on critical protection for advanced packaging and CPO. A wafer‑cutting protective tape is designed to provide efficient protection and support during wafer dicing, while a wafer‑back grinding protective tape safeguards front‑side circuitry and micro‑bumps during back‑grinding thinning and advanced packaging, preventing high‑pressure grinding stress from damaging silicon lines.

Finally, for Micro‑Contamination Reduction, a semiconductor‑grade porous polyolefin filtration membrane can filter advanced chemicals and point‑of‑use solutions, using precise pore‑size control to block nano‑scale impurities, serving as an invisible defense line for wet‑process yield.

Components once seen merely as parts for machine tools and automation equipment—drive components—are now attracting market attention. items.title: 西藏尼泊爾邊境山洪敲響氣候警鐘 聯合國：全球變暖超過1.5℃已不可避免
items.title_en: Flash Flood on the Tibet‑Nepal Border Sounds Climate Alarm; UN Says Global Warming Beyond 1.5°C Is Already Inevitable
paras: 聯合國環境規劃署發布的報告指出，全球氣溫升高超過《巴黎協定》中的攝氏1.5度控制目標已不可避免。即使在最樂觀情況下，全球氣溫也將升高至少1.8度。
根據2016年11月生效的《巴黎協定》，各國同意大幅減少全球溫室氣體排放，確保長期全球平均地表溫度升幅保持在比工業化前高2度以內，並努力將升溫限制在1.5℃以內。
聯合國警告，氣溫每上升一點點，都會加劇破壞性極端天氣，導致冰川融化、生態系統紊亂以及一些島嶼和沿海城市被淹沒。
聯合國指出，到2100年全球氣溫將比工業化前升高3度，可能導致冰川損失超過四分之一，海平面上升多達13釐米。如果沒有有效適應策略，到2050年全球糧食產量可能會下降14%。
聯合國強調，想要限制氣溫升高帶來的損害，人們需要立即持續減少溫室氣體排放，從大氣中去除二氧化碳，這兩者必須同時進行，而不是將其中一項視為替代方案。
聯合國說，只有將全球升溫幅度控制在1.8度以內，本世紀全球平均氣溫升高幅度才能恢復到1.5度，因為尚不能確定大自然固碳的能力，且隨著地球升溫加劇，這種能力可能會隨之下降。
聯合國環境規劃署執行主任Inger Andersen表示，未來將充滿未知，但極端熱浪已經證明氣候變化的影響將來得更快、更猛烈、持續時間更長。
報告作者之一、政府間氣候變化專門委員會聯合主席Debra Roberts呼籲各國儘快調整氣候治理模式，以應對氣候變化超越閾值的問題。這意味著不僅要減少汙染和清除碳排放，還要採取大膽適應措施，保護基礎設施和民生。
報告另一個作者Richard Betts則指出，尼泊爾因岩石和冰川崩塌而引發的土石流災難表明，世界需要限制升溫幅度，回到1.5度以內。人們需要減少排放，限制全球變暖，遏制冰川進一步消融。
paras_en: A report released by the United Nations Environment Programme states that exceeding the 1.5°C temperature‑rise target set in the Paris Agreement has become unavoidable. Even under the most optimistic scenarios, global temperatures will rise by at least 1.8°C.

Under the Paris Agreement, which entered into force in November 2016, countries pledged to cut greenhouse‑gas emissions dramatically so that the long‑term increase in average global surface temperature stays within 2°C above pre‑industrial levels, and to strive to limit warming to 1.5°C.
The UN warns that each incremental rise in temperature intensifies destructive extreme weather, leading to glacier melt, ecosystem disruption, and the submergence of some islands and coastal cities.

The UN notes that by 2100 global temperatures could be 3°C higher than pre‑industrial levels, potentially causing glacier loss of more than a quarter and sea‑level rise of up to 13 cm. Without effective adaptation strategies, global food production could fall by 14% by 2050.

The UN stresses that to limit the damage from warming, humanity must immediately and continuously cut greenhouse‑gas emissions while also removing carbon dioxide from the atmosphere; both actions must be pursued together rather than treating one as a substitute for the other.

The UN says that only by keeping the global temperature increase within 1.8°C can the century‑long average rise be brought back down to 1.5°C, because nature’s carbon‑sequestration capacity remains uncertain and may decline as the planet warms further.

Inger Andersen, Executive Director of the UN Environment Programme, said the future is full of unknowns, but extreme heatwaves have already shown that climate‑change impacts will arrive faster, become more intense, and last longer.

Debra Roberts, co‑chair of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change and one of the report’s authors, called on nations to swiftly adjust climate‑governance frameworks to address the problem of crossing climate thresholds. This means not only cutting pollution and removing carbon but also taking bold adaptation measures to protect infrastructure and livelihoods.

Richard Betts, another author of the report, pointed out that the deadly landslides and rock‑glacier collapses in Nepal illustrate the world’s need to limit warming back to within 1.5°C. Emissions must be reduced, global warming curbed, and further glacier melt halted.

items.title: 南韓政府砸9190億美元豪賭AI　但三星與SK海力士股東為何笑不出來？
items.title_en: South Korean Government Bets $919 billion on AI, Yet Samsung and SK Hynix Shareholders Remain Unconvinced
paras: 南韓政府正把AI抬到國家戰略高度，7月宣佈到2029年建成8.4GW資料中心算力、投資9190億美元，2035年擴大至18.4GW，對此專家表示，數兆韓元籌碼的流向遠比「振興本土」複雜，三星與SK海力士未必完全受惠，輝達則是最大贏家。
專家指出，南韓無先進AI加速器自主供應商，Rebellions、FuriosaAI在部署規模、軟體成熟度上仍難匹敵輝達。三星據悉要興建配備逾5萬顆輝達GPU的AI 工廠；SK電信的2GW DSX AI 工廠將部署搭載旗下HBM4的Vera Rubin系統。
根據SemiAnalysis研判，輝達恐已跟SK海力士就SOCAMM簽長期協議，並鎖定2027年HBM優惠定價與大規模採購承諾，最終條款雖然可能有更改，但方向相當明確，南韓機房建得越多，輝達客戶群與議價權便越大。
對三星與SK海力士股東而言，數兆韓元AI基建規模不等於對等紅利。 HBM與SOCAMM雖帶來銷量，但輝達以長期協議(LTA)鎖價、把記憶體原廠綁進「指定供應商」角色，利潤天花板由買家決定。
專家認為，在本土加速器缺席的情況下，南韓付電費、建機房、買GPU，但價值鏈最厚一段仍外流，且投資人看到的是輝達客戶群擴大，記憶體股股東看到的卻是「賣得多、賺得被動」。
paras_en: The South Korean government is elevating AI to a national‑strategic priority, announcing in July that it will build 8.4 GW of data‑center compute capacity and invest $919 billion by 2029, expanding to 18.4 GW by 2035. Experts say the flow of trillions of won is far more complex than a simple “boost domestic industry” narrative, and Samsung and SK Hynix may not fully benefit, while Nvidia is poised to be the biggest winner.

Experts note that South Korea lacks an indigenous supplier of advanced AI accelerators; companies such as Rebellions and FuriosaAI still lag behind Nvidia in deployment scale and software maturity. Samsung is reportedly planning an AI factory equipped with more than 50,000 Nvidia GPUs, and SK Telecom’s 2 GW DSX AI plant will deploy a Vera Rubin system using its own HBM4 memory.

According to SemiAnalysis, Nvidia is likely already in a long‑term agreement with SK Hynix on SOCAMM, locking in preferential HBM pricing and large‑scale purchase commitments for 2027. While final terms could still change, the direction is clear: the more data‑center capacity South Korea builds, the larger Nvidia’s customer base and bargaining power become.

For Samsung and SK Hynix shareholders, the multi‑trillion‑won AI infrastructure scale does not translate into proportional dividends. HBM and SOCAMM bring volume, but Nvidia’s long‑term agreements lock prices and bind memory manufacturers into a “designated supplier” role, capping profits according to the buyer’s terms.

Experts argue that with no domestic accelerator, South Korea will pay for electricity, build data centers, and buy GPUs, yet the most valuable part of the supply chain still flows abroad. Investors see Nvidia’s expanding customer base, while memory‑stock shareholders see “more sales but passive earnings.”

items.title: 蔡司高層：中國開發EUV落後15年！警告出口管制恐反助本土創新
paras: 艾司摩爾(ASML-US)極紫外光(EUV)微影機光學元件獨家供應商、德國蔡司集團(Zeiss Group)表示，中國在開發最先進晶片製造設備方面，大約落後15年。
蔡司集團半導體事業負責人Frank Rohmund接受彭博電視訪問時表示，北京要開發出EUV微影機，大約還需要15年，這是「合理的推測」，不過他也坦言，中國在這方面的實際進展難以量化。
晶片製造技術是美國阻止中國取得頂尖人工智慧(AI)晶片的重點之一，兩大經濟體正競相開發最先進的AI模型。美國禁止荷蘭艾司摩爾(ASML-US)向中國出口最先進設備，而北京則持續向本土半導體產業投入資金，力求實現晶片自主。
艾司摩爾是目前全球唯一能製造EUV微影機的企業，而EUV技術是生產輝達(NVDA-US)AI加速器等最先進晶片不可或缺的關鍵技術。
Rohmund的預估，呼應瑞銀(UBS)分析師Francois-Xavier Bouvignies等人本周的看法。瑞銀認為，中國至少還需要10年才能自行開發出國產EUV技術。
中國是ASML上一代深紫外光(DUV)晶片製造設備的重要市場之一。美國目前也要求，ASML部分較先進的浸潤式DUV設備出口中國前，必須取得許可。
Rohmund表示，若未來出口管制進一步擴大至傳統DUV設備，將對產業造成不利影響。他說：「我們不相信這些出口管制會帶來正面效果，因為這反而會加速中國的創新。」
中國在浸潤式DUV微影設備的研發與製造上，已取得進展。科技媒體《The Information》7月引述知情人士報導，一家總部位於上海的公司已開始製造這類設備。
Rohmund表示，北京已投入相關技術研發數十年，因此中國近期取得進展「並不令人意外」。
他說：「現在我們必須觀察這些設備實際上究竟有多大的能力。我們目前仍遙遙領先。」
蔡司表示，全球約80%的晶片都使用自家零組件生產。艾司摩爾於2017年以10億歐元(約12億美元)收購蔡司半導體事業的少數股權。
為因應AI帶動的需求，蔡司已擴建德國奧伯科亨(Oberkochen) 總部以增加產能，並正在另一處地點興建新工廠。

items.title: Google推出兩款Gemini 3.8 編程、推理能力升級
items.title_en: Google Launches Gemini 3.8 Programming and Reasoning Enhancements
paras: Google又一次加快了Gemini模型迭代速度，2日（周三）宣布推出Gemini 3.8 Flash和Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber兩款新模型，分別瞄準長周期編程、智慧體工作流與複雜推理，以及網路安全漏洞發現和自動修復。
Google稱，Gemini 3.8是其迄今最強推理和編程模型，兩款模型均通過長時間運行智慧體循環，不斷評估和強化任務執行結果。
距離上一代Gemini 3.7 Flash發表僅過去三周，Google就再次推出新版本。Google表示，此次是六周內第三次發布Flash模型。
獨立AI基準測試機構Artificial Analysis指出，3.8 Flash已是Google不到四個月內推出的第四款Flash模型。
在性能提升的同時，Google繼續維持低價策略：Gemini 3.8 Flash引導價格與3.7 Flash相同，為每百萬輸入Token 0.75美元、每百萬輸出Token 3.75美元，優惠持續至今年年底。
Artificial Analysis評測顯示，3.8 Flash高推理檔在其綜合智慧指數中獲得59分，較3.7 Flash提高3分，並以每項任務約0.58美元的成本進入「智慧程度—任務成本」性價比前沿。
paras_en: Google has once again accelerated the iteration of its Gemini models, announcing on March 2 (Wednesday) the release of two new models, Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber, targeting long‑term programming, intelligent agent workflows, complex reasoning, as well as network security vulnerability detection and automated remediation.

Google says Gemini 3.8 is its strongest reasoning and programming model to date, with both models running long‑term intelligent agent cycles to continuously evaluate and reinforce task execution results.
Only three weeks after the release of the previous Gemini 3.7 Flash, Google has launched another new version. Google states this is the third Flash model release within six weeks.
Independent AI benchmark organization Artificial Analysis noted that 3.8 Flash is the fourth Flash model Google has released in less than four months.

While improving performance, Google continues its low‑price strategy: Gemini 3.8 Flash’s introductory pricing is the same as 3.7 Flash, at $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens, with the discount valid until the end of the year.

Artificial Analysis testing shows 3.8 Flash’s high‑reasoning tier scored 59 points on its composite intelligence index, a 3‑point increase over 3.7 Flash, and it enters the “intelligence level – task cost” cost‑effectiveness frontier at about $0.58 per task.

items.title: 商務部長：Anthropic已與川普政府「修復關係」
items.title_en: Commerce Secretary: Anthropic Has Repaired Relations with the Trump Administration
paras: 《Axios》報導，美國商務部長盧特尼克 (Howard Lutnick) 表示，川普政府如今已恢復對人工智慧新創公司 Anthropic 的信任，顯示雙方歷經數月國安與 AI 安全爭議後，關係出現明顯轉折。
盧特尼克週二接受《Axios》訪問時，被問及是否信任 Anthropic 執行長阿莫戴 (Dario Amodei)。他直言：「我們信任 Anthropic。他們已經按照我們的要求去做，也回到正確的一方，因此答案是肯定的。」
這項表態正值 Anthropic 共同創辦人布朗 (Tom Brown) 更積極參與公司與白宮的互動。盧特尼克週三在北卡羅來納州舉行的二十國集團 (G20) 創新部長會議上，親自向與會官員介紹布朗，並邀請他說明 Anthropic 的發展歷程。
布朗在會中公開肯定川普本週於 Truth Social 發表的資料中心政策主張。他表示，資料中心可創造大量就業與稅收，經過適當規劃後，也能為電網增加更多電力供應；Anthropic同時支持川普政府提出的用電戶保障承諾。
Anthropic與川普政府今年稍早曾因國家安全及 AI 防護限制爆發激烈衝突，加上雙方高層性格差異，使關係進一步惡化，最終導致美方對 Anthropic 最先進模型實施廣泛出口管制。
《Axios》指出，布朗是修復雙方關係的關鍵人物。他曾多次與盧特尼克及美國國家網路總監Sean Cairncross 溝通，協助緩和公司與政府之間的緊張關係。
另一方面，美國聯邦法官 8 月裁定，五角大廈將 Anthropic 列為供應鏈風險並列入黑名單的作法侵犯其憲法權利，因而撤銷相關處分。不過，Anthropic目前仍在華盛頓特區巡迴上訴法院，挑戰五角大廈依另一項法律作出的個別認定。
《Axios》分析，布朗的角色上升，為這家一度與白宮關係緊張的 AI 公司帶來重新出發的機會；對科技業而言，改善與川普政府的關係，也有助於推動自身政策訴求。
paras_en: Axios reports that Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick says the Trump administration has now restored trust in AI startup Anthropic, indicating a clear shift after months of national security and AI safety disputes.

When Lutnick was asked on Tuesday whether he trusts Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, he said plainly, "We trust Anthropic. They have done what we asked and have come back to the right side, so the answer is yes."

This statement comes as Anthropic co‑founder Tom Brown becomes more active in interactions between the company and the White House. On Wednesday, Lutnick introduced Brown to officials at a G20 Innovation Ministers’ Meeting in North Carolina and invited him to explain Anthropic’s development history.

Brown publicly affirmed Trump’s data‑center policy announced on Truth Social that week. He said data centers can create jobs and tax revenue, and with proper planning can also add power to the grid; Anthropic also supports the Trump administration’s promise to protect electricity users.

Earlier this year, Anthropic and the Trump administration clashed over national security and AI protection restrictions, and personality differences at the top further worsened relations, ultimately leading the U.S. to impose broad export controls on Anthropic’s most advanced model.

Axios notes that Brown is the key figure in repairing the relationship. He has repeatedly communicated with Lutnick and National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross, helping to ease tensions between the company and the government.

Meanwhile, a federal judge in August ruled that the Pentagon’s practice of listing Anthropic as a supply‑chain risk and blacklisting it violated its constitutional rights, and therefore revoked the order. Anthropic remains in Washington, D.C., appealing the Pentagon’s individual designation under another law.

Axios analysis says Brown’s elevated role gives the once‑tension‑ridden AI firm a fresh start, and for the tech industry, improving ties with the Trump administration also helps advance its policy goals.

items.title: 二度躲過強制分拆資產命運！美法官駁回司法部分拆AdX要求 但下令谷歌調整商業模式
items.title_en: Second Time Avoiding Forced Asset Split! U.S. Judge Rejects Partial AdX Split but Orders Google to Adjust Business Model
paras: 一名聯邦法官週三(2日)拒絕拆分谷歌的廣告技術業務，而是要求其調整部分商業模式，這家搜索巨頭再次獲得喘息機會，即使多家法院裁定谷歌在網路經濟關鍵領域存在壟斷地位。
2023年，美國司法部試圖透過兩起反壟斷訴訟來限制谷歌的市場主導地位，其中一宗針對該公司網路搜尋業務，另一宗則聚焦於數位廣告技術。維吉尼亞州亞歷山德里亞市的美國地區法官Leonie Brinkema去年4月裁定，谷歌在部分網路廣告銷售市場構成壟斷，司法部隨後提出結構性修正措施，包括要求谷歌出售其廣告交易平台AdX及其他業務。
但在週三，Brinkema駁回政府提出的分拆企業、開放部分平台的訴求。她並表示，將採納 「行為性救濟措施」。完整裁決書以及上述救濟措施細節將保密兩週。
谷歌對這項最新裁決表示歡迎，監管事務副總裁Lee-Anne Mulholland表示，公司對法院駁回司法部拆分相關工具的決定感到「非常滿意」，並稱這些工具幫助小型企業接觸新客戶並實現成長。
針對本廣告科技案件，Blinkma的完整書面判決仍為密封狀態，並保留14天時間供相關方提交必要的刪節內容。因此，法院最終採取的具體行為措施及執行細節，仍須等待完整裁決文件的公布。
AdX是谷歌的廣告交易平台，用於連結廣告需求者與網站及其他廣告資源提供者。它是本案中核心的廣告科技產品之一。
此案與谷歌搜尋反壟斷案不同。2024年，美國哥倫比亞特區地方法院裁定谷歌非法壟斷一般搜尋及搜尋廣告市場。去年9月，案件的更正裁決並未要求谷歌出售Chrome或Android系統，而是禁止其簽訂部分獨家發行協議，並要求競爭對手提供部分搜尋數據及搜尋廣告服務。
paras_en: A federal judge on Wednesday (Feb. 2) rejected a split of Google's advertising technology business, instead ordering the company to adjust parts of its commercial model, giving the search giant another breathing space even as multiple courts have ruled that Google holds monopoly power in key areas of the digital economy.

In 2023, the U.S. Department of Justice sought to curb Google's market dominance through two antitrust lawsuits, one targeting its online search business and another focusing on digital advertising technology. In April last year, U.S. District Judge Leonie Brinkema in Alexandria, Virginia, ruled that Google had a monopoly in certain online advertising sales markets, prompting the DOJ to propose structural remedies, including requiring Google to divest its ad trading platform AdX and other businesses.

However, on Wednesday, Brinkema rejected the government's request to split the company and open parts of its platform. She stated that she would adopt "behavioral remedies." The full decision and details of the remedies will remain confidential for two weeks.

Google welcomed the latest ruling, with Vice President of Regulatory Affairs Lee-Anne Mulholland saying the company was "very satisfied" with the court's decision to reject the DOJ's split of the tools, and noting that these tools help small businesses reach new customers and grow.

Regarding this advertising technology case, Brinkema's full written judgment remains sealed, and a 14‑day period is retained for parties to submit necessary redactions. Therefore, the specific behavioral measures and enforcement details ultimately adopted by the court will have to wait for the full decision to be released.
AdX is Google's ad trading platform that connects advertisers with websites and other advertising resource providers. It is one of the core advertising technology products in this case.

This case differs from Google's search antitrust case. In 2024, the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia ruled that Google illegally monopolized the general search and search advertising markets. In September last year, the amended ruling did not require Google to divest Chrome or Android, but prohibited it from entering certain exclusive distribution agreements and required competitors to provide some search data and search advertising services.

items.title: 〈SEMICON〉明基材首度參展聚焦三主軸 半導體精密材料量產就緒
items.title_en: <SEMICON> Mingji Materials Debuts at Exhibition Focusing on Three Main Pillars; Semiconductor Precision Materials Ready for Mass Production
paras: 明基材(8215-TW)首度參展SEMICON Taiwan 2026，展出半導體精密材料平台布局，董事長陳建志表示，隨著客戶實證與量產就緒，明年半導體材料營收估將顯著成長，雖然初期規模仍不大，但中長期營收比重目標可達2-3成。
陳建志表示，公司將精密高分子與塗佈材料科學的技術創新，從要求極高安全性與潔淨度的醫療材料、光學材料核心技術，整合並拓展至半導體高階製程與光通訊封裝市場，定位為協助半導體客戶突破製程極限的戰略夥伴。
陳建志指出，在策略控制成本與建立高韌性供應鏈的趨勢下，目前半導體精密材料更已通過一線大廠的客戶實證，打造高良率、高穩定與具備 ESG 永續精神的半導體製造鏈，並成為全球大廠信賴的在地高階材料戰略夥伴。
此外，半導體精密材料過去多由日、美等外商長期壟斷，且往往採取材料與特定設備綑綁的封閉模式，使晶圓製造與封測大廠在面臨供應鏈波動時承受極大考驗。
而明碁材在台灣有「十噸級反應釜」的高分子合成與配方微調產能，以及百級無塵室精密塗佈一條龍產線，在地研發與技術支援團隊的快速應對能力，不僅能提供即時在地化支援與穩定高純度供應，更能針對膠材黏度、厚度與擴張特性進行高度客製化開發。
明基材此次展出三大主軸「提升良率」、「優化穩定性」「降低微污染」，將技術優勢對接半導體製程的三大核心效益，全面展示晶圓製程、先進封裝及潔淨製程的關鍵材料解決方案。
在提升良率主軸方面，明基材展出高階 PVA 空氣發泡 CMP 清洗刷輪，為半導體 CMP（化學機械研磨）後段潔淨製程量身打造精準解決業界在微小殘留顆粒與設備產能上的痛點；無塵室專用清潔擦拭布 (Cleanroom Wipe)專為高標準無塵室環境維護設計，有助於降低清潔過程中的微污染風險。
優化製程穩定性主軸應用則聚焦先進封裝與 CPO 的關鍵防護，晶圓切割保護膠帶設計用於晶圓切片製程中提供高效保護與支撐；晶圓背面研磨保護膠帶則針對晶圓背面研磨薄化與先進封裝製程，保護晶圓正面精密線路與微凸塊，防止高壓研磨應力破壞矽晶圓線路。
最後是降低微污染，半導體級聚烯烴多孔過濾膜可過濾高階化學品與 POU (Point-of-Use)，以精準孔徑控制防堵奈米級雜質，成為濕製程良率的隱形防線。
paras_en: Mingji Materials (8215-TW) made its debut at SEMICON Taiwan 2026, showcasing its semiconductor precision materials platform. Chairman Chen Chien‑chi said that with customer validation and mass‑production readiness, semiconductor material revenue is expected to grow significantly next year. Although the initial scale is still modest, the company aims for semiconductor materials to account for 20‑30% of revenue in the medium to long term.

Chen explained that the company will leverage its innovations in precision polymers and coating material science—originally developed for high‑safety, ultra‑clean medical and optical materials—and extend them to advanced semiconductor processes and optical‑communication packaging markets, positioning itself as a strategic partner helping semiconductor customers push process limits.

Chen noted that, amid strategies to control costs and build a resilient supply chain, the company’s precision semiconductor materials have already passed front‑line customer validation at major fabs, delivering high yield, high stability and ESG‑focused sustainability, and becoming trusted local high‑end material partners for global manufacturers.

He added that semiconductor precision materials have long been dominated by foreign firms from Japan and the United States, often sold in closed bundles with specific equipment, which subjects wafer fabs and test houses to severe supply‑chain shocks.

Mingji’s Taiwan facilities include a ten‑ton‑class reactor for polymer synthesis and formulation fine‑tuning, as well as a hundred‑class clean‑room precision coating line. The local R&D and technical support teams can respond quickly, providing on‑site support, stable high‑purity supply, and highly customized development of resin viscosity, thickness and expansion properties.

At the exhibition, Mingji highlighted three pillars: “Yield Improvement,” “Stability Optimization,” and “Micro‑Contamination Reduction,” aligning its technological strengths with the three core benefits of semiconductor processing and showcasing key material solutions for wafer processing, advanced packaging and clean processes.

Under the Yield Improvement pillar, Mingji displayed a high‑end PVA air‑foamed CMP cleaning brush wheel, a precise solution for post‑CMP cleaning that addresses industry pain points of microscopic residue particles and equipment throughput; it also presented a cleanroom‑specific cleaning wipe designed for high‑standard cleanroom maintenance, helping reduce micro‑contamination risk during cleaning.

The Stability Optimization pillar focused on critical protection for advanced packaging and CPO. A wafer‑cutting protective tape is designed to provide efficient protection and support during wafer dicing, while a wafer‑back grinding protective tape safeguards front‑side circuitry and micro‑bumps during back‑grinding thinning and advanced packaging, preventing high‑pressure grinding stress from damaging silicon lines.

Finally, for Micro‑Contamination Reduction, a semiconductor‑grade porous polyolefin filtration membrane can filter advanced chemicals and point‑of‑use solutions, using precise pore‑size control to block nano‑scale impurities, serving as an invisible defense line for wet‑process yield.

Components once seen merely as parts for machine tools and automation equipment—drive components—are now attracting market attention. From ball screws and linear guides to planetary roller screws and harmonic drives, the demand is driven not only by automation but also by the two growth themes of semiconductors and robotics.

The core of drive components is to help equipment achieve precise linear or rotary motion. Hiwin (2049) benefits from rising semiconductor equipment demand, with delivery times for ball screws and linear guides continuously lengthening. Semiconductor demand is already reflected in revenue, gross margins and order visibility, while robotics still has many products in prototyping and validation phases. items.title_en: Gemtek Expands Indian Optical Communications Portfolio with Dixon, Targeting 800G and 1.6T AI Data Center Demand
paras: 2026年09月03日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 網通設備廠正文科技Gemtek Technology(4906-TW)加快布局高速光通訊市場，宣布與印度電子製造大廠Dixon Technologies (India) Limited深化策略合作，雙方將透過印度合資企業擴大光收發模組（Optical Transceivers）、雙向光學次模組（BOSA）及高速光連接產品的製造與市場機會，鎖定寬頻、電信、雲端、資料中心及AI基礎建設需求。
相較正文過去以寬頻、Wi-Fi、光纖與5G網通產品為主要業務，此次合作值得關注的是，公司正進一步擴大高速光通訊產品布局，產品傳輸速率涵蓋1G至1.6T，包括光收發模組、SFP、BOSA及其他高速光連接解決方案，並將技術發展重點推進至800G、1.6T及下一代光子整合技術。
正文表示，公司將運用EIC-PIC光子整合及先進製造能力，因應AI、雲端與資料中心基礎建設帶動的高頻寬、高效能連接需求。隨著AI伺服器運算能力提升，資料中心內部資料傳輸量快速增加，交換器與伺服器之間的高速連接需求同步升級，也使800G、1.6T等高速光通訊技術成為AI基礎建設的重要發展方向。
此次正文與Dixon合作的另一項重點，在於建立印度在地製造能力。雙方將結合正文在光通訊、光子整合及產品開發的技術優勢，以及Dixon在印度的大規模製造、供應鏈管理與當地市場布局，建立可隨需求擴充的光通訊生產平台。
Dixon成立於1993年，總部位於印度諾伊達，是印度大型電子設計與製造服務業者，產品涵蓋消費電子、電信設備及IT硬體等領域，並具備產品設計、工程開發、大規模製造與供應鏈管理能力。
在網通領域，Dixon既有產品包括5G固定無線接取（FWA）設備、光纖網路終端（ONT）及IPTV機上盒等，使其在電信與網通產品量產方面已有一定基礎。正文則提供光通訊、光子整合及高速連接產品開發能力，雙方合作可望把既有網通製造經驗進一步延伸至高速光通訊領域。
印度近年持續提高電子與通訊設備的在地製造比重，正文與Dixon此次合作也將配合當地對光收發模組、BOSA及其他高速光通訊產品的生產需求。透過Dixon既有印度製造及供應鏈體系，正文可在當地建立具規模化能力的生產模式，同時服務印度及全球客戶。
對正文而言，印度產能也將與既有全球製造布局形成互補，有助分散生產區域並提高供應鏈韌性。在AI基礎建設快速擴張之際，高速光通訊供應鏈除了比拚傳輸速率及光子整合技術，量產能力、供應穩定度以及接近終端市場的製造據點，也逐漸成為競爭關鍵。
正文也將於2026年10月7日至10日參加在印度新德里Yashobhoomi舉行的India Mobile Congress（IMC）2026，預計展示1G至1.6T光通訊產品組合，以及應用於寬頻、電信與AI資料中心的光收發模組、BOSA及下一代高速光連接技術。

paras_en: September 3, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – Network equipment maker Gemtek Technology (4906‑TW) is accelerating its push into the high‑speed optical communications market, announcing a deeper strategic partnership with Indian electronics manufacturing leader Dixon Technologies (India) Limited. The two will expand the manufacturing and market opportunities for optical transceivers, bidirectional optical sub‑assemblies (BOSA) and high‑speed optical connectivity products through an Indian joint venture, aiming at broadband, telecom, cloud, data‑center and AI infrastructure demand.

Unlike Gemtek’s historical focus on broadband, Wi‑Fi, fiber and 5G networking products, this partnership is notable for the company’s further expansion into high‑speed optical communications. The product portfolio will cover transmission rates from 1 Gbps up to 1.6 Tbps, including optical transceivers, SFPs, BOSA and other high‑speed optical link solutions, with development emphasis on 800 Gbps, 1.6 Tbps and next‑generation photonic integration technologies.

Gemtek said it will leverage its EIC‑PIC photonic integration and advanced manufacturing capabilities to meet the high‑bandwidth, high‑performance connectivity needs driven by AI, cloud and data‑center infrastructure. As AI server computing power grows, internal data traffic in data centers rises rapidly, prompting upgraded high‑speed links between switches and servers, making 800 Gbps and 1.6 Tbps optical technologies a key focus for AI infrastructure.

Another key aspect of the Gemtek‑Dixon collaboration is building local manufacturing capacity in India. The partners will combine Gemtek’s expertise in optical communications, photonic integration and product development with Dixon’s large‑scale manufacturing, supply‑chain management and local market presence to create a scalable optical‑communications production platform.

Dixon, founded in 1993 and headquartered in Noida, India, is a major Indian electronic design and manufacturing services provider. Its product range spans consumer electronics, telecom equipment and IT hardware, and it possesses capabilities in product design, engineering development, mass production and supply‑chain management.

In the networking sector, Dixon’s existing products include 5G fixed wireless access (FWA) equipment, optical network terminals (ONT) and IPTV set‑top boxes, giving it a solid base in telecom and networking mass production. Gemtek brings optical communications, photonic integration and high‑speed interconnect product development expertise, and the partnership is expected to extend Dixon’s networking manufacturing experience into the high‑speed optical domain.

India has been increasing the local share of electronics and communications equipment manufacturing in recent years. The Gemtek‑Dixon deal aligns with the growing domestic demand for optical transceivers, BOSA and other high‑speed optical components. Leveraging Dixon’s established Indian manufacturing and supply‑chain network, Gemtek can set up a scalable production model locally while serving both Indian and global customers.

For Gemtek, Indian capacity will complement its existing global manufacturing footprint, helping diversify production sites and enhance supply‑chain resilience. As AI infrastructure expands rapidly, the high‑speed optical supply chain is judged not only on transmission speed and photonic integration, but also on volume‑production capability, supply stability and proximity to end‑market manufacturing sites, which are becoming competitive differentiators.

Gemtek will attend the India Mobile Congress (IMC) 2026 in New Delhi’s Yashobhoomi from October 7‑10, 2026, where it plans to showcase a product suite ranging from 1 Gbps to 1.6 Tbps, including optical transceivers, BOSA and next‑generation high‑speed optical link technologies for broadband, telecom and AI data‑center applications.

items.title: 台達電、奇鋐等供應鏈吃香！AI資料中心狂擴建  變壓器、液冷需求爆發
paras: 人工智慧（AI）熱潮持續推升全球資料中心建置需求，市場焦點雖多集中在輝達(NVDA-US) 等AI晶片大廠，但隨著電力供應與散熱成為資料中心擴建的關鍵瓶頸，變壓器、電力設備及冷卻系統供應商也逐漸成為這波AI基礎建設投資的受惠者。
根據《路透》報導，麥肯錫（McKinsey）預估，到2030年全球資料中心投資規模將接近7兆美元；輝達上週也表示，預期AI支出未來數年仍將維持強勁。
然而，資料中心建置速度正受到基礎設施限制。顧問公司Pivotale AI指出，超大規模雲端服務商通常希望資料中心能在6個月內交付，但部分新興市場的電網接入可能延遲最長24個月，主要已開發市場甚至可能超過8年。
數位基礎設施服務商BodaData執行長Wing Kin Cheung表示：「在業界之外，人們談論的是圖形處理器（GPU）；但在業界內，人們最關心的絕對是發電機與變壓器的交貨時間。」
變壓器主要負責將電網輸送的高壓電轉換為適合伺服器、冷卻系統及電力配送設備使用的電壓。

變壓器需求爆發　韓中廠商訂單大增

AI基礎設施投資升溫，已直接反映在變壓器供應商的訂單表現。
南韓電力設備與能源解決方案製造商HD Hyundai Electric與中國電力設備供應商金盤科技(688676-CN) 均表示，2026年上半年AI基礎建設專案帶動變壓器需求大幅增加，尤其北美市場表現突出。
HD Hyundai Electric近期指出，隨著美國超大規模雲端業者擴大在芬蘭、德國及英國等歐洲市場的投資，當地需求也持續成長，中東市場需求則維持強勁。
截至6月底，HD Hyundai Electric訂單積壓金額較半年前增加23%，達85億美元。公司預期資料中心需求仍將維持強勁。
HD Hyundai Electric表示，目前訂單積壓已涵蓋超過3年的產能，其中主要電力設備未來3年的部分產能已獲得保障，公司甚至已與部分主要客戶洽談交付時間延伸至2030年的訂單。
金盤科技的資料中心新訂單則更為強勁。2026年上半年資料中心相關新訂單較去年同期增加逾4倍，相關訂單積壓量也接近增加3倍。

AI晶片耗電暴增　固態變壓器成新焦點

隨著AI晶片功耗不斷提高，資料中心業者不僅需要更多電力設備，也開始尋求提升能源效率、降低環境負荷的技術。
美國銀行（Bank of America）引用輝達的產品路線圖估計，到2030年底，單一AI機櫃的耗電量可能攀升至超過1.5MW，接近傳統機櫃的100倍。
固態變壓器（solid-state transformer，SST）就是其中一項受到關注的技術。這種設備以半導體取代大型磁性線圈與銅繞組，用於轉換及傳輸電力。
瑞銀（UBS）估計，SST可提升約4%的電力效率並降低成本。雖然目前商業化應用仍處於早期階段，但該行預期SST滲透率到2030年可達40%，並認為中國企業可能憑藉技術能力及成本優勢取得更大市占。
HD Hyundai Electric與金盤科技均表示，正在深化SST技術的開發；台灣主要電力基礎設施供應商台達電(2308-TW) 則表示，目前已有一座小型資料中心採用其SST產品。
台達電指出，AI電力、散熱及資料中心基礎設施解決方案仍是公司成長動能之一，並正擴大泰國、美國及中國的生產布局，以因應需求增加。

AI散熱需求升溫　液冷2030年占比估達70%

除了供電之外，散熱也成為AI資料中心擴建的另一項核心需求。隨著高功耗AI晶片產生更多熱量，資料中心對冷卻設備的需求同步增加。
美銀亞太區基礎材料、石油與天然氣研究主管Matty Zhao指出，電力與散熱基本上相互依存，資料中心使用的電力越多，產生的熱量越高，也就需要更多散熱能力。
美銀預估，到2030年，液冷將占新建AI資料中心冷卻系統的70%，相較目前約30%的比例大幅提升。麥肯錫則指出，液冷技術可降低超過27%的能源消耗。
資料中心開發商也開始探索更非傳統的建置方式，包括漂浮式設施、水下資料中心，以及將伺服器部署於洞穴或隧道中，為更多設備供應商創造市場機會。
HD Hyundai Electric表示，隨著資料中心自發電及漂浮式資料中心市場擴大，也為船用中速引擎業者進入新市場創造機會。
熱管理產品需求強勁成長，也帶動輝達生態系供應商，包括台達電、台灣散熱解決方案供應商奇鋐(3017-TW) 與雙鴻(3324-TW) ，以及中國英維克(002837-CN) 的需求。

供應鏈訂單旺　投資人開始擔心估值與競爭

儘管資料中心相關設備訂單持續增加，但供應商股價漲勢已開始降溫，原因包括市場對高估值以及產業競爭加劇的疑慮升高。
台達電今年股價已上漲逾90%；HD Hyundai Electric則大致持平，較去年超過100%的漲幅明顯降溫。中國金盤科技與英維克今年股價則分別下跌近30%與20%，此前兩家公司在2025年分別大漲118%及244%。
台達電董事長鄭平在7月表示，即使營收持續增加，毛利率可能仍大致維持目前水準；市場同時存在新產品平台、部署延遲及零組件短缺等多項變數，相關問題今年下半年可能進一步加劇。
美銀則提醒投資人，AI資料中心供應鏈並非所有業者都能成為贏家。真正能持續取得客戶與訂單的龍頭供應商，才可能在這波基礎建設擴張中脫穎而出。

paras: 9/3台股盤前要聞

1. The Taiwan index closed at a low of 46,164.72 points on the 2nd, down 784 points, breaking below the 5‑day moving average but holding above the 46,000 mark. Turnover was NT$9,183.93 billion. Foreign investors switched from buying to selling, net selling NT$913.55 billion, mainly selling 51,000 lots of 00981A (Unified Taiwan Stock Growth), 45,000 lots of United Microelectronics, and reducing holdings in TSMC by about 12,000 lots. At the same time, they also went short on Taiwan index futures, with net short positions jumping by 6,623 contracts.

2. Renewed military clashes between the United States and Iran have pushed up international oil prices, and the resulting risk‑off sentiment has strengthened the US dollar. On the 2nd, both the Taipei stock and foreign exchange markets weakened. With hot money pulling out rapidly, the New Taiwan dollar briefly fell past the NT$31.8 per US$ barrier, ending the session at NT$31.728, a depreciation of 9.5 cents and a weekly low. The total turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange markets expanded to US$3.748 billion.

3. Google (GOOG‑US) participated in the SEMICON Memory Summit, where senior director of supply‑chain infrastructure Nikhil Cherian said DRAM supply is extremely tight. Google has begun recycling DDR4 from decommissioned servers and integrating it into its latest‑generation AI servers, but even that is insufficient, prompting a call for memory manufacturers to ramp up production quickly. Industry observers interpret this move as confirming that the DDR4 and overall DRAM shortage is serious and could extend DDR4’s service life.

4. The Taiwan Stock Exchange and the OTC market announced on the 2nd the addition of several stocks to the disposition list, including optical‑lens maker Largan Precision (3008‑TW) whose price exceeds NT$1,000, cooling‑solution firm Shuang Hong (3324‑TW), optical‑communication company Lian Jun (3450‑TW) and Qian Ding (4908‑TW). Disposition will start on the 3rd. Except for Lian Jun, which will be suspended until September 11 (seven days), the other three will be halted until September 9, with trading in each block occurring in 2‑minute intervals.

5. AI demand continues to grow at a breakneck pace, putting unprecedented expansion pressure on the semiconductor supply chain. TSMC (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) senior vice‑president and deputy COO Hou Yong‑qing said on the 2nd that AI demand is not only massive in scale but also changing far faster than past industry experience. Using TSMC’s equipment needs as an example, the equipment volume estimated at the end of last year for this year was 1×; after just one quarter it rose to 1.5×, and by July it had reached 1.9× – essentially a near‑doubling of demand within six months, forcing the whole semiconductor ecosystem to rethink its response.

6. Hon Hai (Foxconn) chairman Liu Yang‑wei said at the Semiconductor Masters Forum on the 2nd that from a system integrator’s perspective, the current AI industry demand is not only “fast” but “extremely, extremely large” in scale. Consequently, supply‑chain players face expansion pressure, but they also worry whether the added capacity can be recovered later – a common concern among many suppliers.
Foreign investors flipped to net selling of NT$913 billion and aggressively shorted futures, cutting 51,000 lots of 00981A and 45,000 lots of United Microelectronics.
Hot money outflow hit both stocks and forex, widening the NT$ depreciation to nearly 0.10, closing at NT$31.728.
Four soaring stocks including Largan Precision and Shuang Hong will be suspended from tomorrow; three will be disposed until 9/9 and Lian Jun until 9/11.
At SEMICON, Hou Yong‑qing said AI demand will double within six months, requiring a re‑structuring of supply‑chain cooperation.
At SEMICON, Liu Yang‑wei of Hon Hai said AI demand is both huge and fast, putting expansion pressure on suppliers.
At SEMICON, Ying‑Wai announced strong AI project launches, with capacity to increase by at least 50 % in Q2‑Q3 next year.
Major banks’ silicon‑photonic testing and positioning platform shipments are ramping up, with order visibility extending to Q2 next year.
Pegatron’s ‘T1 project’ AI server first batch ships for the autumn harvest; Tong Zixian said this AI wave has only just begun.
Taiwan‑US cooperation opens a new chapter; Gong Ming‑xin rushed to the US to “add” another US$20 billion, sparking another investment surge.
Google is even salvaging DDR4 for reuse and urgently urging DRAM makers to expand capacity; Nanya and Winbond stand to benefit.
At SEMICON, Google said TPU generations may arrive every six months and that the mass‑production model still needs to accelerate.

items.title: 博通財報快評｜客製AI晶片需求爆發，2027財年AI半導體營收上看1,150億美元
items.title_en: Broadcom Earnings Quick Take: Custom AI Chip Demand Booms, FY2027 AI Semiconductor Revenue Projected at $115 Billion
paras: 2026年09月03日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 博通2026財年第3季截至8月2日，淨利達130.9億美元，高於去年同期的41.4億美元，每股盈餘由0.85美元增至2.68美元；排除特定一次性項目後，調整後每股盈餘為3.32美元，高於分析師預估的3.22美元。
第3季營收則由去年同期159.5億美元大幅增加至295.9億美元，高於市場預估的292.4億美元。
AI半導體成為博通最重要的成長引擎之一。公司第3季AI半導體營收達167億美元，其中客製化晶片業務占73%，換算約122億美元，顯示大型AI業者自行設計專用加速晶片的趨勢持續擴大。
博通預估，2026財年第4季AI半導體營收將進一步增加至217億美元，較第3季的167億美元增加約30%，反映AI運算基礎建設需求仍快速成長。
陳福陽指出，目前AI工作負載絕大多數的運算需求，來自少數開發最先進前沿模型的大型業者，而這些客戶的運算基礎建設需求預計在2027年及2028年進一步加速，整體需求仍呈快速成長。
從客戶產品進度來看，博通已開始出貨Google最新一代TPU，以及OpenAI代號「Jalapeño」的客製化AI晶片，同時已投入OpenAI第2代及第3代晶片開發。Meta的客製化晶片則預計自2026財年第4季開始出貨。
這項進展顯示，博通在AI市場的角色已不僅是網路與連接晶片供應商，客製化AI加速晶片正快速成為另一項主要成長來源。大型雲端與AI模型業者為降低對單一GPU架構的依賴，並針對自身AI工作負載改善效能與成本，持續投入ASIC等客製化晶片開發，也為博通帶來新的成長空間。
博通對後續AI業務展望更為積極。陳福陽表示，公司已取得足夠供應，可支撐2027財年AI半導體營收倍增至1,150億美元，並已能看到2028財年再度倍增至2,300億美元的發展路徑。
換言之，若公司目標順利實現，博通AI半導體營收將在兩個財年間呈現大幅成長。陳福陽並表示，目前實際需求甚至高於上述展望，公司將持續設法增加供應能力。
供應端因此成為後續成長的重要觀察指標。包括AI晶片業者及其他科技公司目前均面臨記憶體供應瓶頸，在AI伺服器需求快速增加之下，記憶體供應與成本可能影響AI基礎建設擴張速度。對博通而言，能否取得足夠晶片、記憶體及相關供應鏈產能，將直接影響客製化AI晶片需求轉化為實際營收的速度。
整體業績方面，博通預估2026財年第4季總營收將增至348億美元，略高於分析師預估的346.8億美元。財報公布後，博通股價盤後一度下跌，隨後收復跌幅，最新大致持平。

paras_en: September 3, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Broadcom’s FY2026 Q3 ended August 2 posted net income of $13.09 billion, up from $4.14 billion a year earlier, with earnings per share rising from $0.85 to $2.68; on an adjusted basis excluding special items, EPS was $3.32, beating analysts’ $3.22 estimate.
Q3 revenue jumped sharply to $29.59 billion from $15.95 billion a year ago, topping the market forecast of $29.24 billion.

AI semiconductors have become one of Broadcom’s key growth engines. In Q3, AI semiconductor revenue reached $16.7 billion, of which custom‑chip business accounted for 73% – roughly $12.2 billion – indicating that large AI players are increasingly designing their own dedicated accelerators.

Broadcom projects AI semiconductor revenue to rise further to $21.7 billion in FY2026 Q4, about a 30% increase over the Q3 level, reflecting continued rapid growth in AI compute infrastructure demand.

Chen Fuyang noted that today the vast majority of AI workload compute demand comes from a handful of large players developing the most advanced frontier models, and that these customers’ infrastructure needs are expected to accelerate further in 2027 and 2028, keeping overall demand on a fast‑growth trajectory.

From a product‑timeline perspective, Broadcom has begun shipping Google’s latest‑generation TPU and OpenAI’s custom AI chip codenamed “Jalapeño,” and is already involved in development of OpenAI’s second‑ and third‑generation chips. Meta’s custom chip is slated to ship starting FY2026 Q4.

This progress shows Broadcom’s role in the AI market is no longer limited to networking and connectivity chips; custom AI accelerators are quickly becoming another major growth source. Large cloud and AI‑model providers are investing in ASIC‑type custom chips to reduce reliance on a single GPU architecture and to improve performance and cost for their own workloads, opening new growth space for Broadcom.

Broadcom is even more bullish on its AI outlook. Chen Fuyang said the company now has sufficient supply to support AI semiconductor revenue doubling to $115 billion in FY2027, and sees a path to another doubling to $230 billion in FY2028.

In other words, if the targets are met, Broadcom’s AI semiconductor revenue would grow dramatically over two fiscal years. Chen added that actual demand is already exceeding the outlook, and the company will keep expanding supply capacity.

Supply constraints therefore become a key watch‑point for future growth. Both AI‑chip makers and other tech firms are facing memory‑supply bottlenecks, and as AI server demand surges, memory availability and cost could affect the pace of AI infrastructure expansion. For Broadcom, securing enough chips, memory and related supply‑chain capacity will directly impact how quickly custom AI chip demand translates into revenue.

Overall, Broadcom expects FY2026 Q4 total revenue to rise to $34.8 billion, slightly above analysts’ $34.68 billion estimate. After the earnings release, the stock fell in after‑hours trading before recovering, ending roughly flat.

items.title: 蔡司高層：中國開發EUV落後15年！警告出口管制恐反助本土創新
paras: 艾司摩爾(ASML-US)極紫外光(EUV)微影機光學元件獨家供應商、德國蔡司集團(Zeiss Group)表示，中國在開發最先進晶片製造設備方面，大約落後15年。
蔡司集團半導體事業負責人Frank Rohmund接受彭博電視訪問時表示，北京要開發出EUV微影機，大約還需要15年，這是「合理的推測」，不過他也坦言，中國在這方面的實際進展難以量化。
晶片製造技術是美國阻止中國取得頂尖人工智慧(AI)晶片的重點之一，兩大經濟體正競相開發最先進的AI模型。美國禁止荷蘭艾司摩爾(ASML-US)向中國出口最先進設備，而北京則持續向本土半導體產業投入資金，力求實現晶片自主。
艾司摩爾是目前全球唯一能製造EUV微影機的企業，而EUV技術是生產輝達(NVDA-US)AI加速器等最先進晶片不可或缺的關鍵技術。
Rohmund的預估，呼應瑞銀(UBS)分析師Francois-Xavier Bouvignies等人本周的看法。瑞銀認為，中國至少還需要10年才能自行開發出國產EUV技術。
中國是ASML上一代深紫外光(DUV)晶片製造設備的重要市場之一。美國目前也要求，ASML部分較先進的浸潤式DUV設備出口中國前，必須取得許可。
Rohmund表示，若未來出口管制進一步擴大至傳統DUV設備，將對產業造成不利影響。他說：「我們不相信這些出口管制會帶來正面效果，因為這反而會加速中國的創新。」
中國在浸潤式DUV微影設備的研發與製造上，已取得進展。科技媒體《The Information》7月引述知情人士報導，一家總部位於上海的公司已開始製造這類設備。
Rohmund表示，北京已投入相關技術研發數十年，因此中國近期取得進展「並不令人意外」。
他說：「現在我們必須觀察這些設備實際上究竟有多大的能力。我們目前仍遙遙領先。」
蔡司表示，全球約80%的晶片都使用自家零組件生產。艾司摩爾於2017年以10億歐元(約12億美元)收購蔡司半導體事業的少數股權。
為因應AI帶動的需求，蔡司已擴建德國奧伯科亨(Oberkochen) 總部以增加產能，並正在另一處地點興建新工廠。

items.title: Google推出兩款Gemini 3.8 編程、推理能力升級
items.title_en: Google Launches Gemini 3.8 Programming and Reasoning Enhancements
paras: Google又一次加快了Gemini模型迭代速度，2日（周三）宣布推出Gemini 3.8 Flash和Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber兩款新模型，分別瞄準長周期編程、智慧體工作流與複雜推理，以及網路安全漏洞發現和自動修復。
Google稱，Gemini 3.8是其迄今最強推理和編程模型，兩款模型均通過長時間運行智慧體循環，不斷評估和強化任務執行結果。
距離上一代Gemini 3.7 Flash發表僅過去三周，Google就再次推出新版本。Google表示，此次是六周內第三次發布Flash模型。
獨立AI基準測試機構Artificial Analysis指出，3.8 Flash已是Google不到四個月內推出的第四款Flash模型。
在性能提升的同時，Google繼續維持低價策略：Gemini 3.8 Flash引導價格與3.7 Flash相同，為每百萬輸入Token 0.75美元、每百萬輸出Token 3.75美元，優惠持續至今年年底。
Artificial Analysis評測顯示，3.8 Flash高推理檔在其綜合智慧指數中獲得59分，較3.7 Flash提高3分，並以每項任務約0.58美元的成本進入「智慧程度—任務成本」性價比前沿。
paras_en: Google has once again accelerated the iteration of its Gemini models, announcing on March 2 (Wednesday) the release of two new models, Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber, targeting long‑term programming, intelligent agent workflows, complex reasoning, as well as network security vulnerability detection and automated remediation.

Google says Gemini 3.8 is its strongest reasoning and programming model to date, with both models running long‑term intelligent agent cycles to continuously evaluate and reinforce task execution results.
Only three weeks after the release of the previous Gemini 3.7 Flash, Google has launched another new version. Google states this is the third Flash model release within six weeks.
Independent AI benchmark organization Artificial Analysis noted that 3.8 Flash is the fourth Flash model Google has released in less than four months.

While improving performance, Google continues its low‑price strategy: Gemini 3.8 Flash’s introductory pricing is the same as 3.7 Flash, at $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens, with the discount valid until the end of the year.

Artificial Analysis testing shows 3.8 Flash’s high‑reasoning tier scored 59 points on its composite intelligence index, a 3‑point increase over 3.7 Flash, and it enters the “intelligence level – task cost” cost‑effectiveness frontier at about $0.58 per task.

paras: 2026年09月03日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股週三反彈，AI概念股持續扮演盤面焦點，但企業財報公布後股價表現分歧。戴爾科技Dell Technologies(DELL-US)、輝達Nvidia(NVDA-US)走強，Palo Alto Networks(PANW-US)、MongoDB(MDB-US)則因財報遭遇賣壓；盤後Snowflake(SNOW-US)大漲逾20%，博通Broadcom(AVGO-US)與慧與科技Hewlett Packard Enterprise(HPE-US)走低。市場下一個焦點轉向特斯拉Tesla(TSLA-US)即將舉行的Cybercab無人計程車發表會。
美股主要指數週三全面收紅，道瓊工業指數上漲0.6%，標普500指數上漲0.5%，那斯達克綜合指數上漲0.45%，小型股羅素2000指數表現相對突出，上漲1.1%。
盤後期貨市場變化不大，道瓊期貨小幅下跌，標普500與那斯達克100期貨也略微走低。
AI硬體股仍是支撐大盤的重要趨勢。戴爾科技公布財報後股價大漲15.8%，收在492美元；輝達同步上漲3.2%，收在224.41美元。兩檔個股走強，也反映市場持續關注AI伺服器、加速運算及資料中心基礎建設需求。
不過，AI供應鏈並非全面上漲。高速連接晶片業者Credo Technology(CRDO-US)雖然財報優於市場預期並上調展望，但市場擔憂利潤率表現，股價仍重挫20%。
這也顯示，隨著AI相關企業股價與市場預期持續墊高，投資人評估財報的標準已不再只是營收是否成長，而是進一步檢視訂單、需求、利潤率與財測能否持續超越市場預期。
盤後財報以Snowflake(SNOW-US)表現最突出，股價在延長交易時段大漲逾20%，成為最新一波企業財報行情中的亮點。
相較之下，NetApp(NTAP-US)盤後下跌，慧與科技股價也明顯走低。博通盤後一度出現較大跌幅，隨後跌幅收斂；公司財報略優於市場預期，但財測稍低於預期，使投資人對後續成長動能保持審慎。
博通是AI資料中心晶片與高速網路的重要供應商，其營運展望也被市場視為觀察大型雲端服務商AI基礎建設支出的指標之一。在市場對AI需求抱持高度期待之際，即使企業營運維持成長，只要財測未能明顯超越預期，股價仍可能面臨壓力。
軟體股則成為週三盤面的主要弱勢族群。資安業者Palo Alto Networks公布財報後股價重挫9.3%，MongoDB下跌13.5%。受到個股財報表現拖累，iShares Expanded Tech-Software Sector ETF同步下跌2.6%，顯示賣壓已由個別公司擴散至軟體族群。
相較科技軟體股走弱，資金持續流向農業相關類股，包括肥料業者CF Industries(CF-US)、Nutrien(NTR-US)及農業機械大廠Deere(DE-US)均有不錯表現，相關農業ETF也同步走強。
生技與製藥類股同樣受到市場青睞，Exelixis(EXEL-US)與輝瑞Pfizer(PFE-US)股價走強。記憶體族群方面，SanDisk(SNDK-US)與美光Micron Technology(MU-US)則相對平淡，市場持續觀察記憶體需求及價格變化。
商品市場方面，美國原油價格週三上漲0.9%，來到每桶91.01美元，本週以來累計上漲9.1%；美國10年期公債殖利率大致持平在4.79%。油價快速走高，也使能源成本是否重新增加通膨壓力，成為市場觀察利率前景的重要變數。
在企業財報之外，特斯拉Cybercab將成為週四市場另一項焦點。特斯拉預計在德州奧斯汀舉行Cybercab無人計程車發表活動，目前尚未公布確切時間，市場預期可能安排在美股收盤後。
近期Cybercab已多次出現在奧斯汀街頭，特斯拉也持續釋出無人計程車即將推出的訊號。公司目前已在奧斯汀工廠生產數百輛Cybercab，因此市場關注重點將從產品展示進一步轉向商業化，包括實際投入道路營運的車輛數量、服務推出時程，以及未來能否擴大至更多地區。
特斯拉股價最新上漲0.3%，來到357.10美元。隨著Cybercab活動登場，投資人將聚焦公司是否公布更明確的無人計程車量產、營運規模及商業模式，相關訊息也將牽動市場對自駕車與實體AI產業後續發展的預期。

paras_en: September 3, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center reporting) – U.S. stocks rebounded on Wednesday, with AI‑related shares remaining the market focus, but post‑earnings price moves were mixed. Dell Technologies (DELL-US) and Nvidia (NVDA-US) rallied, while Palo Alto Networks (PANW-US) and MongoDB (MDB-US) faced selling pressure after their reports; after‑hours Snowflake (SNOW-US) jumped more than 20%, whereas Broadcom (AVGO-US) and Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE-US) fell. The next market spotlight shifts to Tesla’s (TSLA-US) upcoming Cybercab autonomous‑taxi launch.

U.S. major indices all closed higher on Wednesday: the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.6%, the S&P 500 gained 0.5%, the Nasdaq Composite added 0.45%, and the small‑cap Russell 2000 outperformed with a 1.1% increase.
After‑hours futures showed little change: Dow futures slipped slightly, while S&P 500 and Nasdaq‑100 futures also edged lower.

AI‑hardware stocks continued to underpin the market. Dell Technologies’ shares surged 15.8% after its earnings, closing at $492; Nvidia rose 3.2% to $224.41. The strength of these two stocks reflects ongoing market interest in AI servers, accelerated computing and data‑center infrastructure demand.

However, the AI supply chain did not rise uniformly. High‑speed interconnect chip maker Credo Technology (CRDO-US) beat expectations and raised its outlook, yet concerns over profit margins drove the stock down about 20%.

This illustrates that as AI‑related valuations and expectations climb, investors now judge earnings not just on revenue growth but also on order flow, demand, margins and whether guidance can consistently exceed market forecasts.
In after‑hours trading, Snowflake (SNOW-US) was the standout, with its share price soaring over 20% in the extended session, becoming the brightest spot in the latest earnings round‑up.

By contrast, NetApp (NTAP-US) fell after hours and HPE’s stock also slipped noticeably. Broadcom experienced a brief sharp drop before narrowing losses; its earnings were slightly ahead of expectations, but guidance fell short, prompting investors to remain cautious about future growth momentum.

Broadcom is a key supplier of AI data‑center chips and high‑speed networking, and its outlook is watched as a barometer of large cloud providers’ AI infrastructure spending. Even with solid operating growth, a guidance that does not clearly beat expectations can still weigh on the stock amid high AI demand expectations.

Software stocks were the main weak spot on Wednesday. Cyber‑security firm Palo Alto Networks saw its share price plunge 9.3% after its report, and MongoDB fell 13.5%. The sell‑off spread to the sector, with the iShares Expanded Tech‑Software Sector ETF down 2.6%, indicating pressure moving from individual companies to the broader software group.

While tech software weakened, capital continued flowing into agriculture‑related equities, with fertilizer maker CF Industries (CF-US), Nutrien (NTR-US) and farm‑equipment giant Deere (DE-US) all posting solid gains, and related agriculture ETFs also advancing.

Biotech and pharma also enjoyed market favor, with Exelixis (EXEL-US) and Pfizer (PFE-US) posting gains. In the memory segment, SanDisk (SNDK-US) and Micron Technology (MU-US) were relatively flat as the market watches memory demand and pricing trends.

On the commodities side, U.S. crude oil rose 0.9% on Wednesday to $91.01 per barrel, up 9.1% for the week; the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield held around 4.79%. The rapid oil price rise revives concerns that higher energy costs could rekindle inflation pressures, a key factor in rate‑ outlook assessments.

Beyond earnings, Tesla’s Cybercab will be another market focus on Thursday. Tesla plans to hold a Cybercab autonomous‑taxi unveiling in Austin, Texas, with the exact timing not yet disclosed, though the market expects it may occur after the U.S. market close.

Cybercab has been spotted repeatedly on Austin streets recently, and Tesla continues to signal an imminent rollout. The company already produces several hundred Cybercabs at its Austin plant, shifting market attention from the showcase to commercialization – including the number of vehicles slated for road operation, service rollout timelines, and potential expansion to other regions.

Tesla’s stock was up 0.3% at $357.10. As the Cybercab event approaches, investors will watch for clearer details on autonomous‑taxi mass production, operational scale and business model, which could influence expectations for the broader self‑driving and applied‑AI industries.

items.title: 商務部長：Anthropic已與川普政府「修復關係」
items.title_en: Commerce Secretary: Anthropic Has Repaired Relations with the Trump Administration
paras: 《Axios》報導，美國商務部長盧特尼克 (Howard Lutnick) 表示，川普政府如今已恢復對人工智慧新創公司 Anthropic 的信任，顯示雙方歷經數月國安與 AI 安全爭議後，關係出現明顯轉折。
盧特尼克週二接受《Axios》訪問時，被問及是否信任 Anthropic 執行長阿莫戴 (Dario Amodei)。他直言：「我們信任 Anthropic。他們已經按照我們的要求去做，也回到正確的一方，因此答案是肯定的。」
這項表態正值 Anthropic 共同創辦人布朗 (Tom Brown) 更積極參與公司與白宮的互動。盧特尼克週三在北卡羅來納州舉行的二十國集團 (G20) 創新部長會議上，親自向與會官員介紹布朗，並邀請他說明 Anthropic 的發展歷程。
布朗在會中公開肯定川普本週於 Truth Social 發表的資料中心政策主張。他表示，資料中心可創造大量就業與稅收，經過適當規劃後，也能為電網增加更多電力供應；Anthropic同時支持川普政府提出的用電戶保障承諾。
Anthropic與川普政府今年稍早曾因國家安全及 AI 防護限制爆發激烈衝突，加上雙方高層性格差異，使關係進一步惡化，最終導致美方對 Anthropic 最先進模型實施廣泛出口管制。
《Axios》指出，布朗是修復雙方關係的關鍵人物。他曾多次與盧特尼克及美國國家網路總監Sean Cairncross 溝通，協助緩和公司與政府之間的緊張關係。
另一方面，美國聯邦法官 8 月裁定，五角大廈將 Anthropic 列為供應鏈風險並列入黑名單的作法侵犯其憲法權利，因而撤銷相關處分。不過，Anthropic目前仍在華盛頓特區巡迴上訴法院，挑戰五角大廈依另一項法律作出的個別認定。
《Axios》分析，布朗的角色上升，為這家一度與白宮關係緊張的 AI 公司帶來重新出發的機會；對科技業而言，改善與川普政府的關係，也有助於推動自身政策訴求。
paras_en: Axios reports that Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick says the Trump administration has now restored trust in AI startup Anthropic, indicating a clear shift after months of national security and AI safety disputes.

When Lutnick was asked on Tuesday whether he trusts Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, he said plainly, "We trust Anthropic. They have done what we asked and have come back to the right side, so the answer is yes."

This statement comes as Anthropic co‑founder Tom Brown becomes more active in interactions between the company and the White House. On Wednesday, Lutnick introduced Brown to officials at a G20 Innovation Ministers’ Meeting in North Carolina and invited him to explain Anthropic’s development history.

Brown publicly affirmed Trump’s data‑center policy announced on Truth Social that week. He said data centers can create jobs and tax revenue, and with proper planning can also add power to the grid; Anthropic also supports the Trump administration’s promise to protect electricity users.

Earlier this year, Anthropic and the Trump administration clashed over national security and AI protection restrictions, and personality differences at the top further worsened relations, ultimately leading the U.S. to impose broad export controls on Anthropic’s most advanced model.

Axios notes that Brown is the key figure in repairing the relationship. He has repeatedly communicated with Lutnick and National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross, helping to ease tensions between the company and the government.

Meanwhile, a federal judge in August ruled that the Pentagon’s practice of listing Anthropic as a supply‑chain risk and blacklisting it violated its constitutional rights, and therefore revoked the order. Anthropic remains in Washington, D.C., appealing the Pentagon’s individual designation under another law.

Axios analysis says Brown’s elevated role gives the once‑tension‑ridden AI firm a fresh start, and for the tech industry, improving ties with the Trump administration also helps advance its policy goals.

items.title: 二度躲過強制分拆資產命運！美法官駁回司法部分拆AdX要求 但下令谷歌調整商業模式
items.title_en: Second Time Avoiding Forced Asset Split! U.S. Judge Rejects Partial AdX Split but Orders Google to Adjust Business Model
paras: 一名聯邦法官週三(2日)拒絕拆分谷歌的廣告技術業務，而是要求其調整部分商業模式，這家搜索巨頭再次獲得喘息機會，即使多家法院裁定谷歌在網路經濟關鍵領域存在壟斷地位。
2023年，美國司法部試圖透過兩起反壟斷訴訟來限制谷歌的市場主導地位，其中一宗針對該公司網路搜尋業務，另一宗則聚焦於數位廣告技術。維吉尼亞州亞歷山德里亞市的美國地區法官Leonie Brinkema去年4月裁定，谷歌在部分網路廣告銷售市場構成壟斷，司法部隨後提出結構性修正措施，包括要求谷歌出售其廣告交易平台AdX及其他業務。
但在週三，Brinkema駁回政府提出的分拆企業、開放部分平台的訴求。她並表示，將採納 「行為性救濟措施」。完整裁決書以及上述救濟措施細節將保密兩週。
谷歌對這項最新裁決表示歡迎，監管事務副總裁Lee-Anne Mulholland表示，公司對法院駁回司法部拆分相關工具的決定感到「非常滿意」，並稱這些工具幫助小型企業接觸新客戶並實現成長。
針對本廣告科技案件，Blinkma的完整書面判決仍為密封狀態，並保留14天時間供相關方提交必要的刪節內容。因此，法院最終採取的具體行為措施及執行細節，仍須等待完整裁決文件的公布。
AdX是谷歌的廣告交易平台，用於連結廣告需求者與網站及其他廣告資源提供者。它是本案中核心的廣告科技產品之一。
此案與谷歌搜尋反壟斷案不同。2024年，美國哥倫比亞特區地方法院裁定谷歌非法壟斷一般搜尋及搜尋廣告市場。去年9月，案件的更正裁決並未要求谷歌出售Chrome或Android系統，而是禁止其簽訂部分獨家發行協議，並要求競爭對手提供部分搜尋數據及搜尋廣告服務。
paras_en: A federal judge on Wednesday (Feb. 2) rejected a split of Google's advertising technology business, instead ordering the company to adjust parts of its commercial model, giving the search giant another breathing space even as multiple courts have ruled that Google holds monopoly power in key areas of the digital economy.

In 2023, the U.S. Department of Justice sought to curb Google's market dominance through two antitrust lawsuits, one targeting its online search business and another focusing on digital advertising technology. In April last year, U.S. District Judge Leonie Brinkema in Alexandria, Virginia, ruled that Google had a monopoly in certain online advertising sales markets, prompting the DOJ to propose structural remedies, including requiring Google to divest its ad trading platform AdX and other businesses.

However, on Wednesday, Brinkema rejected the government's request to split the company and open parts of its platform. She stated that she would adopt "behavioral remedies." The full decision and details of the remedies will remain confidential for two weeks.

Google welcomed the latest ruling, with Vice President of Regulatory Affairs Lee-Anne Mulholland saying the company was "very satisfied" with the court's decision to reject the DOJ's split of the tools, and noting that these tools help small businesses reach new customers and grow.

Regarding this advertising technology case, Brinkema's full written judgment remains sealed, and a 14‑day period is retained for parties to submit necessary redactions. Therefore, the specific behavioral measures and enforcement details ultimately adopted by the court will have to wait for the full decision to be released.
AdX is Google's ad trading platform that connects advertisers with websites and other advertising resource providers. It is one of the core advertising technology products in this case.

This case differs from Google's search antitrust case. In 2024, the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia ruled that Google illegally monopolized the general search and search advertising markets. In September last year, the amended ruling did not require Google to divest Chrome or Android, but prohibited it from entering certain exclusive distribution agreements and required competitors to provide some search data and search advertising services.

items.title: Palantir重挫5.8% 債券殖利率、Google雙重利空？
items.title_en: Palantir Slides 5.8% Amid Rising Bond Yields and Dual Headwinds from Google
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，Palantir(PLTR-US)在8月財報公布後股價強勁反彈，如今昂貴的估值再次面臨壓力。一名專家指出，全球債券殖利率走升，再度對高估值成長股造成壓力。
Palantir股價向來以大幅上漲與劇烈拉回聞名。周三的股價走勢再次凸顯後者。Palantir在8月財報公布後反彈，如今漲勢反轉，該股周三收盤下跌5.8%，成為標普500指數表現第四差股票。本周截至目前，Palantir已下跌9%，今年以來則下跌4.7%。
Palantir目前的預估本益比為82倍，估值溢價相當高。高本益比也讓股價容易劇烈波動，因為任何新聞或最新發展，都可能讓市場對這檔已被高度看好的股票失去耐心。Palantir目前的估值水準其實已較2025年底的高峰大幅收斂，當時預估本益比一度超過230倍。
Founders ETFs投資組合經理Michael Monaghan表示，「過去幾天債券殖利率走高，因此我認為這可能使一些高本益比股票承壓。」
全球政府債券利率持續攀升，並升至2008年以來未見水準。債券殖利率走升可能推高整體利率，進而增加借貸成本，這可能促使資金從股票轉向債券。高本益比成長股的估值，往往很大一部分來自預期未來才能實現的現金流，而非當下的獲利，而利率升高則會提高未來現金流的折現率，進而壓低這類股票的估值。
Monaghan指出，Alphabet周二推出Gemini 3.8 Flash及Flash Cyber，也可能成為Palantir股價的另一項阻力。Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber可透過Google的Fairwind計畫提供給政府機構及資安合作夥伴。一些投資人可能將這項發展解讀為Google直接挑戰Palantir的政府業務。
Palantir近期股價下跌，與上個月的表現形成對比。Palantir股價6月底觸及52周低點106.37美元後，在第二季財報優於預期帶動下反彈，因公司商業業務成長強勁，並上修全年展望。
Monaghan表示，投資人可能對Palantir能否長期維持目前的成長速度抱持懷疑。他補充，公司必須持續超越市場預期，才能「配得上」目前估值。
Jefferies分析師Brent Thill上個月在Palantir公布第二季財報後的報告中，也表達了類似看法。「我們從基本面來看確實看好Palantir，但目前估值幾乎沒有為成長正常化或執行表現不如預期留下任何空間。」
paras_en: MarketWatch reported that Palantir (PLTR-US) saw a strong rebound after its August earnings release, but its lofty valuation is now under pressure again. An expert noted that rising global bond yields are once more weighing on high‑multiple growth stocks.

Palantir’s stock is known for big jumps and sharp pullbacks. Wednesday’s price action highlighted the latter. After rebounding post‑August earnings, the rally reversed and the shares closed down 5.8% on Wednesday, making it the fourth‑worst performer in the S&P 500. So far this week Palantir is down 9%, and it’s down 4.7% year‑to‑date.

Palantir currently trades at an estimated price‑to‑earnings ratio of 82×, indicating a very high valuation premium. Such a high P/E makes the stock prone to volatile moves, as any news or development can erode market patience for a stock that’s already highly favored. The current valuation level has actually narrowed sharply from its peak at the end of 2025, when the P/E briefly topped 230×.
Founders ETFs portfolio manager Michael Monaghan said, “Bond yields have been rising over the past few days, so I think that could put pressure on some high‑multiple stocks.”

Global government bond yields continue to climb, reaching levels not seen since 2008. Higher yields can push overall interest rates up, raising borrowing costs and potentially shifting capital from equities to bonds. Valuations of high‑multiple growth stocks are largely based on expected future cash flows rather than current earnings, and higher rates increase the discount rate applied to those cash flows, thereby lowering the stocks’ valuations.

Monaghan added that Alphabet’s launch on Tuesday of Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash Cyber could also be a headwind for Palantir’s share price. Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber can be offered to government agencies and cybersecurity partners through Google’s Fairwind program, and some investors may view this as Google directly challenging Palantir’s government business.

Palantir’s recent share decline contrasts with its performance last month. After hitting a 52‑week low of $106.37 at the end of June, the stock rebounded on better‑than‑expected second‑quarter results, driven by strong commercial growth and an upward revision of its full‑year outlook.

Monaghan said investors might be skeptical about Palantir’s ability to sustain its current growth rate over the long term. He added that the company must continue to beat market expectations to “earn” its present valuation.

Jefferies analyst Brent Thill, in a report last month following Palantir’s second‑quarter earnings release, expressed a similar view: “Fundamentally we remain bullish on Palantir, but the current valuation leaves virtually no room for growth to normalize or for execution to fall short of expectations.”

items.title: 西藏尼泊爾邊境山洪敲響氣候警鐘 聯合國：全球變暖超過1.5℃已不可避免
items.title_en: Flash Flood on the Tibet‑Nepal Border Sounds Climate Alarm; UN Says Global Warming Beyond 1.5°C Is Already Inevitable
paras: 聯合國環境規劃署發布的報告指出，全球氣溫升高超過《巴黎協定》中的攝氏1.5度控制目標已不可避免。即使在最樂觀情況下，全球氣溫也將升高至少1.8度。
根據2016年11月生效的《巴黎協定》，各國同意大幅減少全球溫室氣體排放，確保長期全球平均地表溫度升幅保持在比工業化前高2度以內，並努力將升溫限制在1.5℃以內。
聯合國警告，氣溫每上升一點點，都會加劇破壞性極端天氣，導致冰川融化、生態系統紊亂以及一些島嶼和沿海城市被淹沒。
聯合國指出，到2100年全球氣溫將比工業化前升高3度，可能導致冰川損失超過四分之一，海平面上升多達13釐米。如果沒有有效適應策略，到2050年全球糧食產量可能會下降14%。
聯合國強調，想要限制氣溫升高帶來的損害，人們需要立即持續減少溫室氣體排放，從大氣中去除二氧化碳，這兩者必須同時進行，而不是將其中一項視為替代方案。
聯合國說，只有將全球升溫幅度控制在1.8度以內，本世紀全球平均氣溫升高幅度才能恢復到1.5度，因為尚不能確定大自然固碳的能力，且隨著地球升溫加劇，這種能力可能會隨之下降。
聯合國環境規劃署執行主任Inger Andersen表示，未來將充滿未知，但極端熱浪已經證明氣候變化的影響將來得更快、更猛烈、持續時間更長。
報告作者之一、政府間氣候變化專門委員會聯合主席Debra Roberts呼籲各國儘快調整氣候治理模式，以應對氣候變化超越閾值的問題。這意味著不僅要減少汙染和清除碳排放，還要採取大膽適應措施，保護基礎設施和民生。
報告另一個作者Richard Betts則指出，尼泊爾因岩石和冰川崩塌而引發的土石流災難表明，世界需要限制升溫幅度，回到1.5度以內。人們需要減少排放，限制全球變暖，遏制冰川進一步消融。
paras_en: A report released by the United Nations Environment Programme states that exceeding the 1.5°C temperature‑rise target set in the Paris Agreement has become unavoidable. Even under the most optimistic scenarios, global temperatures will rise by at least 1.8°C.

Under the Paris Agreement, which entered into force in November 2016, countries pledged to cut greenhouse‑gas emissions dramatically so that the long‑term increase in average global surface temperature stays within 2°C above pre‑industrial levels, and to strive to limit warming to 1.5°C.
The UN warns that each incremental rise in temperature intensifies destructive extreme weather, leading to glacier melt, ecosystem disruption, and the submergence of some islands and coastal cities.

The UN notes that by 2100 global temperatures could be 3°C higher than pre‑industrial levels, potentially causing glacier loss of more than a quarter and sea‑level rise of up to 13 cm. Without effective adaptation strategies, global food production could fall by 14% by 2050.

The UN stresses that to limit the damage from warming, humanity must immediately and continuously cut greenhouse‑gas emissions while also removing carbon dioxide from the atmosphere; both actions must be pursued together rather than treating one as a substitute for the other.

The UN says that only by keeping the global temperature increase within 1.8°C can the century‑long average rise be brought back down to 1.5°C, because nature’s carbon‑sequestration capacity remains uncertain and may decline as the planet warms further.

Inger Andersen, Executive Director of the UN Environment Programme, said the future is full of unknowns, but extreme heatwaves have already shown that climate‑change impacts will arrive faster, become more intense, and last longer.

Debra Roberts, co‑chair of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change and one of the report’s authors, called on nations to swiftly adjust climate‑governance frameworks to address the problem of crossing climate thresholds. This means not only cutting pollution and removing carbon but also taking bold adaptation measures to protect infrastructure and livelihoods.

Richard Betts, another author of the report, pointed out that the deadly landslides and rock‑glacier collapses in Nepal illustrate the world’s need to limit warming back to within 1.5°C. Emissions must be reduced, global warming curbed, and further glacier melt halted.

items.title: 博通財報快評｜客製AI晶片需求爆發，2027財年AI半導體營收上看1,150億美元
items.title_en: Broadcom Earnings Quick Take: Custom AI Chip Demand Booms, FY2027 AI Semiconductor Revenue Projected at $115 Billion
paras: 2026年09月03日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 博通2026財年第3季截至8月2日，淨利達130.9億美元，高於去年同期的41.4億美元，每股盈餘由0.85美元增至2.68美元；排除特定一次性項目後，調整後每股盈餘為3.32美元，高於分析師預估的3.22美元。
第3季營收則由去年同期159.5億美元大幅增加至295.9億美元，高於市場預估的292.4億美元。
AI半導體成為博通最重要的成長引擎之一。公司第3季AI半導體營收達167億美元，其中客製化晶片業務占73%，換算約122億美元，顯示大型AI業者自行設計專用加速晶片的趨勢持續擴大。
博通預估，2026財年第4季AI半導體營收將進一步增加至217億美元，較第3季的167億美元增加約30%，反映AI運算基礎建設需求仍快速成長。
陳福陽指出，目前AI工作負載絕大多數的運算需求，來自少數開發最先進前沿模型的大型業者，而這些客戶的運算基礎建設需求預計在2027年及2028年進一步加速，整體需求仍呈快速成長。
從客戶產品進度來看，博通已開始出貨Google最新一代TPU，以及OpenAI代號「Jalapeño」的客製化AI晶片，同時已投入OpenAI第2代及第3代晶片開發。Meta的客製化晶片則預計自2026財年第4季開始出貨。
這項進展顯示，博通在AI市場的角色已不僅是網路與連接晶片供應商，客製化AI加速晶片正快速成為另一項主要成長來源。大型雲端與AI模型業者為降低對單一GPU架構的依賴，並針對自身AI工作負載改善效能與成本，持續投入ASIC等客製化晶片開發，也為博通帶來新的成長空間。
博通對後續AI業務展望更為積極。陳福陽表示，公司已取得足夠供應，可支撐2027財年AI半導體營收倍增至1,150億美元，並已能看到2028財年再度倍增至2,300億美元的發展路徑。
換言之，若公司目標順利實現，博通AI半導體營收將在兩個財年間呈現大幅成長。陳福陽並表示，目前實際需求甚至高於上述展望，公司將持續設法增加供應能力。
供應端因此成為後續成長的重要觀察指標。包括AI晶片業者及其他科技公司目前均面臨記憶體供應瓶頸，在AI伺服器需求快速增加之下，記憶體供應與成本可能影響AI基礎建設擴張速度。對博通而言，能否取得足夠晶片、記憶體及相關供應鏈產能，將直接影響客製化AI晶片需求轉化為實際營收的速度。
整體業績方面，博通預估2026財年第4季總營收將增至348億美元，略高於分析師預估的346.8億美元。財報公布後，博通股價盤後一度下跌，隨後收復跌幅，最新大致持平。

paras_en: September 3, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Broadcom’s FY2026 Q3 ended August 2 posted net income of $13.09 billion, up from $4.14 billion a year earlier, with earnings per share rising from $0.85 to $2.68; on an adjusted basis excluding special items, EPS was $3.32, beating analysts’ $3.22 estimate.
Q3 revenue jumped sharply to $29.59 billion from $15.95 billion a year ago, topping the market forecast of $29.24 billion.

AI semiconductors have become one of Broadcom’s key growth engines. In Q3, AI semiconductor revenue reached $16.7 billion, of which custom‑chip business accounted for 73% – roughly $12.2 billion – indicating that large AI players are increasingly designing their own dedicated accelerators.

Broadcom projects AI semiconductor revenue to rise further to $21.7 billion in FY2026 Q4, about a 30% increase over the Q3 level, reflecting continued rapid growth in AI compute infrastructure demand.

Chen Fuyang noted that today the vast majority of AI workload compute demand comes from a handful of large players developing the most advanced frontier models, and that these customers’ infrastructure needs are expected to accelerate further in 2027 and 2028, keeping overall demand on a fast‑growth trajectory.

From a product‑timeline perspective, Broadcom has begun shipping Google’s latest‑generation TPU and OpenAI’s custom AI chip codenamed “Jalapeño,” and is already involved in development of OpenAI’s second‑ and third‑generation chips. Meta’s custom chip is slated to ship starting FY2026 Q4.

This progress shows Broadcom’s role in the AI market is no longer limited to networking and connectivity chips; custom AI accelerators are quickly becoming another major growth source. Large cloud and AI‑model providers are investing in ASIC‑type custom chips to reduce reliance on a single GPU architecture and to improve performance and cost for their own workloads, opening new growth space for Broadcom.

Broadcom is even more bullish on its AI outlook. Chen Fuyang said the company now has sufficient supply to support AI semiconductor revenue doubling to $115 billion in FY2027, and sees a path to another doubling to $230 billion in FY2028.

In other words, if the targets are met, Broadcom’s AI semiconductor revenue would grow dramatically over two fiscal years. Chen added that actual demand is already exceeding the outlook, and the company will keep expanding supply capacity.

Supply constraints therefore become a key watch‑point for future growth. Both AI‑chip makers and other tech firms are facing memory‑supply bottlenecks, and as AI server demand surges, memory availability and cost could affect the pace of AI infrastructure expansion. For Broadcom, securing enough chips, memory and related supply‑chain capacity will directly impact how quickly custom AI chip demand translates into revenue.

Overall, Broadcom expects FY2026 Q4 total revenue to rise to $34.8 billion, slightly above analysts’ $34.68 billion estimate. After the earnings release, the stock fell in after‑hours trading before recovering, ending roughly flat.

items.title: 南韓政府砸9190億美元豪賭AI　但三星與SK海力士股東為何笑不出來？
items.title_en: South Korean Government Bets $919 billion on AI, Yet Samsung and SK Hynix Shareholders Remain Unconvinced
paras: 南韓政府正把AI抬到國家戰略高度，7月宣佈到2029年建成8.4GW資料中心算力、投資9190億美元，2035年擴大至18.4GW，對此專家表示，數兆韓元籌碼的流向遠比「振興本土」複雜，三星與SK海力士未必完全受惠，輝達則是最大贏家。
專家指出，南韓無先進AI加速器自主供應商，Rebellions、FuriosaAI在部署規模、軟體成熟度上仍難匹敵輝達。三星據悉要興建配備逾5萬顆輝達GPU的AI 工廠；SK電信的2GW DSX AI 工廠將部署搭載旗下HBM4的Vera Rubin系統。
根據SemiAnalysis研判，輝達恐已跟SK海力士就SOCAMM簽長期協議，並鎖定2027年HBM優惠定價與大規模採購承諾，最終條款雖然可能有更改，但方向相當明確，南韓機房建得越多，輝達客戶群與議價權便越大。
對三星與SK海力士股東而言，數兆韓元AI基建規模不等於對等紅利。 HBM與SOCAMM雖帶來銷量，但輝達以長期協議(LTA)鎖價、把記憶體原廠綁進「指定供應商」角色，利潤天花板由買家決定。
專家認為，在本土加速器缺席的情況下，南韓付電費、建機房、買GPU，但價值鏈最厚一段仍外流，且投資人看到的是輝達客戶群擴大，記憶體股股東看到的卻是「賣得多、賺得被動」。
paras_en: The South Korean government is elevating AI to a national‑strategic priority, announcing in July that it will build 8.4 GW of data‑center compute capacity and invest $919 billion by 2029, expanding to 18.4 GW by 2035. Experts say the flow of trillions of won is far more complex than a simple “boost domestic industry” narrative, and Samsung and SK Hynix may not fully benefit, while Nvidia is poised to be the biggest winner.

Experts note that South Korea lacks an indigenous supplier of advanced AI accelerators; companies such as Rebellions and FuriosaAI still lag behind Nvidia in deployment scale and software maturity. Samsung is reportedly planning an AI factory equipped with more than 50,000 Nvidia GPUs, and SK Telecom’s 2 GW DSX AI plant will deploy a Vera Rubin system using its own HBM4 memory.

According to SemiAnalysis, Nvidia is likely already in a long‑term agreement with SK Hynix on SOCAMM, locking in preferential HBM pricing and large‑scale purchase commitments for 2027. While final terms could still change, the direction is clear: the more data‑center capacity South Korea builds, the larger Nvidia’s customer base and bargaining power become.

For Samsung and SK Hynix shareholders, the multi‑trillion‑won AI infrastructure scale does not translate into proportional dividends. HBM and SOCAMM bring volume, but Nvidia’s long‑term agreements lock prices and bind memory manufacturers into a “designated supplier” role, capping profits according to the buyer’s terms.

Experts argue that with no domestic accelerator, South Korea will pay for electricity, build data centers, and buy GPUs, yet the most valuable part of the supply chain still flows abroad. Investors see Nvidia’s expanding customer base, while memory‑stock shareholders see “more sales but passive earnings.”

items.title: 蔡司高層：中國開發EUV落後15年！警告出口管制恐反助本土創新
paras: 艾司摩爾(ASML-US)極紫外光(EUV)微影機光學元件獨家供應商、德國蔡司集團(Zeiss Group)表示，中國在開發最先進晶片製造設備方面，大約落後15年。
蔡司集團半導體事業負責人Frank Rohmund接受彭博電視訪問時表示，北京要開發出EUV微影機，大約還需要15年，這是「合理的推測」，不過他也坦言，中國在這方面的實際進展難以量化。
晶片製造技術是美國阻止中國取得頂尖人工智慧(AI)晶片的重點之一，兩大經濟體正競相開發最先進的AI模型。美國禁止荷蘭艾司摩爾(ASML-US)向中國出口最先進設備，而北京則持續向本土半導體產業投入資金，力求實現晶片自主。
艾司摩爾是目前全球唯一能製造EUV微影機的企業，而EUV技術是生產輝達(NVDA-US)AI加速器等最先進晶片不可或缺的關鍵技術。
Rohmund的預估，呼應瑞銀(UBS)分析師Francois-Xavier Bouvignies等人本周的看法。瑞銀認為，中國至少還需要10年才能自行開發出國產EUV技術。
中國是ASML上一代深紫外光(DUV)晶片製造設備的重要市場之一。美國目前也要求，ASML部分較先進的浸潤式DUV設備出口中國前，必須取得許可。
Rohmund表示，若未來出口管制進一步擴大至傳統DUV設備，將對產業造成不利影響。他說：「我們不相信這些出口管制會帶來正面效果，因為這反而會加速中國的創新。」
中國在浸潤式DUV微影設備的研發與製造上，已取得進展。科技媒體《The Information》7月引述知情人士報導，一家總部位於上海的公司已開始製造這類設備。
Rohmund表示，北京已投入相關技術研發數十年，因此中國近期取得進展「並不令人意外」。
他說：「現在我們必須觀察這些設備實際上究竟有多大的能力。我們目前仍遙遙領先。」
蔡司表示，全球約80%的晶片都使用自家零組件生產。艾司摩爾於2017年以10億歐元(約12億美元)收購蔡司半導體事業的少數股權。
為因應AI帶動的需求，蔡司已擴建德國奧伯科亨(Oberkochen) 總部以增加產能，並正在另一處地點興建新工廠。

items.title: Google推出兩款Gemini 3.8 編程、推理能力升級
items.title_en: Google Launches Gemini 3.8 Programming and Reasoning Enhancements
paras: Google又一次加快了Gemini模型迭代速度，2日（周三）宣布推出Gemini 3.8 Flash和Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber兩款新模型，分別瞄準長周期編程、智慧體工作流與複雜推理，以及網路安全漏洞發現和自動修復。
Google稱，Gemini 3.8是其迄今最強推理和編程模型，兩款模型均通過長時間運行智慧體循環，不斷評估和強化任務執行結果。
距離上一代Gemini 3.7 Flash發表僅過去三周，Google就再次推出新版本。Google表示，此次是六周內第三次發布Flash模型。
獨立AI基準測試機構Artificial Analysis指出，3.8 Flash已是Google不到四個月內推出的第四款Flash模型。
在性能提升的同時，Google繼續維持低價策略：Gemini 3.8 Flash引導價格與3.7 Flash相同，為每百萬輸入Token 0.75美元、每百萬輸出Token 3.75美元，優惠持續至今年年底。
Artificial Analysis評測顯示，3.8 Flash高推理檔在其綜合智慧指數中獲得59分，較3.7 Flash提高3分，並以每項任務約0.58美元的成本進入「智慧程度—任務成本」性價比前沿。
paras_en: Google has once again accelerated the iteration of its Gemini models, announcing on March 2 (Wednesday) the release of two new models, Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber, targeting long‑term programming, intelligent agent workflows, complex reasoning, as well as network security vulnerability detection and automated remediation.

Google says Gemini 3.8 is its strongest reasoning and programming model to date, with both models running long‑term intelligent agent cycles to continuously evaluate and reinforce task execution results.
Only three weeks after the release of the previous Gemini 3.7 Flash, Google has launched another new version. Google states this is the third Flash model release within six weeks.
Independent AI benchmark organization Artificial Analysis noted that 3.8 Flash is the fourth Flash model Google has released in less than four months.

While improving performance, Google continues its low‑price strategy: Gemini 3.8 Flash’s introductory pricing is the same as 3.7 Flash, at $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens, with the discount valid until the end of the year.

Artificial Analysis testing shows 3.8 Flash’s high‑reasoning tier scored 59 points on its composite intelligence index, a 3‑point increase over 3.7 Flash, and it enters the “intelligence level – task cost” cost‑effectiveness frontier at about $0.58 per task.

items.title: Snowflake盤後飆逾20%AI股財報行情分歧、特斯拉Cybercab接棒登場
items.title_en: Snowflake Surges Over 20% After Hours as AI Stock Earnings Diverge; Tesla Cybercab Takes Center Stage
paras: 2026年09月03日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股週三反彈，AI概念股持續扮演盤面焦點，但企業財報公布後股價表現分歧。戴爾科技Dell Technologies(DELL-US)、輝達Nvidia(NVDA-US)走強，Palo Alto Networks(PANW-US)、MongoDB(MDB-US)則因財報遭遇賣壓；盤後Snowflake(SNOW-US)大漲逾20%，博通Broadcom(AVGO-US)與慧與科技Hewlett Packard Enterprise(HPE-US)走低。市場下一個焦點轉向特斯拉Tesla(TSLA-US)即將舉行的Cybercab無人計程車發表會。
美股主要指數週三全面收紅，道瓊工業指數上漲0.6%，標普500指數上漲0.5%，那斯達克綜合指數上漲0.45%，小型股羅素2000指數表現相對突出，上漲1.1%。
盤後期貨市場變化不大，道瓊期貨小幅下跌，標普500與那斯達克100期貨也略微走低。
AI硬體股仍是支撐大盤的重要趨勢。戴爾科技公布財報後股價大漲15.8%，收在492美元；輝達同步上漲3.2%，收在224.41美元。兩檔個股走強，也反映市場持續關注AI伺服器、加速運算及資料中心基礎建設需求。
不過，AI供應鏈並非全面上漲。高速連接晶片業者Credo Technology(CRDO-US)雖然財報優於市場預期並上調展望，但市場擔憂利潤率表現，股價仍重挫20%。
這也顯示，隨著AI相關企業股價與市場預期持續墊高，投資人評估財報的標準已不再只是營收是否成長，而是進一步檢視訂單、需求、利潤率與財測能否持續超越市場預期。
盤後財報以Snowflake(SNOW-US)表現最突出，股價在延長交易時段大漲逾20%，成為最新一波企業財報行情中的亮點。
相較之下，NetApp(NTAP-US)盤後下跌，慧與科技股價也明顯走低。博通盤後一度出現較大跌幅，隨後跌幅收斂；公司財報略優於市場預期，但財測稍低於預期，使投資人對後續成長動能保持審慎。
博通是AI資料中心晶片與高速網路的重要供應商，其營運展望也被市場視為觀察大型雲端服務商AI基礎建設支出的指標之一。在市場對AI需求抱持高度期待之際，即使企業營運維持成長，只要財測未能明顯超越預期，股價仍可能面臨壓力。
軟體股則成為週三盤面的主要弱勢族群。資安業者Palo Alto Networks公布財報後股價重挫9.3%，MongoDB下跌13.5%。受到個股財報表現拖累，iShares Expanded Tech-Software Sector ETF同步下跌2.6%，顯示賣壓已由個別公司擴散至軟體族群。
相較科技軟體股走弱，資金持續流向農業相關類股，包括肥料業者CF Industries(CF-US)、Nutrien(NTR-US)及農業機械大廠Deere(DE-US)均有不錯表現，相關農業ETF也同步走強。
生技與製藥類股同樣受到市場青睞，Exelixis(EXEL-US)與輝瑞Pfizer(PFE-US)股價走強。記憶體族群方面，SanDisk(SNDK-US)與美光Micron Technology(MU-US)則相對平淡，市場持續觀察記憶體需求及價格變化。
商品市場方面，美國原油價格週三上漲0.9%，來到每桶91.01美元，本週以來累計上漲9.1%；美國10年期公債殖利率大致持平在4.79%。油價快速走高，也使能源成本是否重新增加通膨壓力，成為市場觀察利率前景的重要變數。
在企業財報之外，特斯拉Cybercab將成為週四市場另一項焦點。特斯拉預計在德州奧斯汀舉行Cybercab無人計程車發表活動，目前尚未公布確切時間，市場預期可能安排在美股收盤後。
近期Cybercab已多次出現在奧斯汀街頭，特斯拉也持續釋出無人計程車即將推出的訊號。公司目前已在奧斯汀工廠生產數百輛Cybercab，因此市場關注重點將從產品展示進一步轉向商業化，包括實際投入道路營運的車輛數量、服務推出時程，以及未來能否擴大至更多地區。
特斯拉股價最新上漲0.3%，來到357.10美元。隨著Cybercab活動登場，投資人將聚焦公司是否公布更明確的無人計程車量產、營運規模及商業模式，相關訊息也將牽動市場對自駕車與實體AI產業後續發展的預期。
